camera_method: Assumed level camera with optical shift; hand-observed silhouette controls placed on rays at assumed depths. Not a recovered survey camera.

scale_anchor.source: Nominal glazed entry height 2.5 m; foreground adult height 1.75 m as qualitative plausibility check
scale_anchor.uncertainty: No measured scale; at least 25 percent possible absolute-scale variation; depth less constrained

observed_features: Continuous pale shell flowing from ground through front arch and taller right wing
Large curved main curtain wall with dark vertical mullions
assumptions: Single photograph fixes projected contours but cannot uniquely determine freeform surface depths or absolute dimensions.
Eye height assumed 1.9 m; focal length 39.6 mm on 36 mm sensor; image principal point [1000,1080].
Roof geometry is a coherent loft through photo-derived front and rear curves, with assumed depths approximately 62 to 149 m from camera.
Nominal floor height 4.0 m is an assumption. Actual storey count is unknown; only one exterior-envelope storey and ground slab are authored.
Rear enclosure is a plain inferred wall under a short curved roof return. No unseen rooms, floorplates, furnishings, or structural system are modelled.

Glazing is represented by individual semantic curtain panels and mullions. Reflected colours are approximated with a small untextured palette; fine reflections and visible light streaks are not reproduced.
Roof panel joints are simplified into combined cladding-joint systems. Complex construction layers and subpixel fixing details are omitted.
Plaza and sky are render-only context; surrounding city buildings, people and vegetation are omitted.
semantic_structure: IfcProject > IfcSite > IfcBuilding > IfcBuildingStorey > exterior elements; curtain panels and mullions aggregate under IfcCurtainWall

photographic_evidence.limitations: Landmark agreement is limited to fitted contour points. It does not establish independent reconstruction accuracy or full silhouette agreement.

visual_review.front_preview: Main roof gesture, crests, central arch and left low opening reproduced. Mullion rhythm simplified. Soffit shadow, glazing reflections and narrow right edge differ from photograph.
visual_review.rear_preview: Coherent roof depth and inferred rear wall reviewed in draft-rear-check.png; hidden enclosure remains schematic.
visual_review.final: Final comparison.png inspected. Overall exterior form is recognisable; simplified reflected colour blocks, façade rhythm, right-edge return and deeper soffit shadow remain visible deviations.

stopping_reason: Dominant visible exterior completed and semantic gate passed. Further precision in unseen freeform depth and glazing reflections is unsupported by this single view; remaining simplifications are documented.
